property_summary: For every admissible input, the reference C's Collect reverts/or leaves balance untouched while block.timestamp <= unlockTime (strict >), so a caller cannot collect at the exact unlock timestamp; the mutant allows collection at block.timestamp == unlockTime, so the collect at the boundary succeeds and balance decreases — a boundary behavior the reference never permits.
change_summary: Change the unlockTime check from > acc.unlockTime to >= acc.unlockTime, allowing collection at the exact unlock timestamp.
